desc:
💵 Debt Hunt is a game with a procedural generation, where your goal is to earn as much money as possible to pay off a debt owed to the ruthless corporation and collection agency known as "Debt Hunt". 

🐺 To succeed, you'll have to face constant danger, especially from a monster that begins its hunt at sunset.

⚠️ Original concept idea and game is made by NZTeam, all credits are going to them ⚠️
🛠️ Game is still in Alpha, many things are subject to change, and some things may break 🛠️
